mapper.sql: select ws.skill_id, ws.worker_id, ws.community_id, ws.skill_tags, ws.work_status, ws.current_load, ws.total_finished, ws.avg_response, ws.create_by, ws.create_time, ws.update_by, ws.update_time, u.nick_name as worker_name, u.phonenumber as worker_phone, c.community_name as community_name from worker_skill ws left join sys_user u on ws.worker_id = u.user_id left join community c on ws.community_id = c.community_id
mapper.insert: insert into worker_skill ( worker_id, community_id, skill_tags, work_status, current_load, total_finished, avg_response, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{workerId}, #{communityId}, #{skillTags}, ifnull(#{workStatus}, '0'), ifnull(#{currentLoad}, 0), ifnull(#{totalFinished}, 0), ifnull(#{avgResponse}, 0), #{createBy}, sysdate() )
